plan.scope: Post-diagnostic local experiment only; tournament version frozen and untouched; no promotion claim from training
plan.hypothesis: Evaluate first-seer-investigation choices by terminal wins over BOTH winning and losing B0 deals; hidden roles and future votes are labels/evaluator data, never policy inputs.

training.pool: all seer-role B0 records in causal251/252calibration, not just selected100losses
training.actions: six ascending ranks of currently legal living investigation targets; rank5 is high-seat B0 mirror
training.intervention: only firstnight investigation; complete fresh replay of all later B0/background policies
training.selection: largest pooled paired terminal-win gain; ties prefer rank5, then descending rank; require a positive gain on each training seed, otherwise retain rank5/B0; no new variants after outcomes

candidate.features: own legal seer role, day1, no prior investigations, seven living seats, sorted offered legal targets; no opponent names/types, evaluator seed or hidden worlds
candidate.unchanged: all wolf/villager behavior, later investigations, all day votes and chats and private fact protection

development_replication.compare: selected fixed rank versus B0 on same deals
development_replication.skip_if: rank5 selected or train gains not positive on both seeds

plan.confirmation: 39701/39702 and independent opponent-family testing remain unused unless a candidate qualifies; no empirical-strength claim from reused251/252training; unchanged2pp/nonregression bar
plan.limits: Even expected-value improvement on fixed scripted opponents may fail unseen opponents; initial observation lacks enough information to identify exact wolves. This is a six-action statistical pilot, not a general learned Werewolf policy.

selection_rule: largest pooled paired terminal-win gain; ties prefer rank5, then descending rank; require a positive gain on each training seed, otherwise retain rank5/B0; no new variants after outcomes
